members.name: bisect
members.doc: Return the index where to insert item x in list a, assuming a is sorted. The return value i is such that all e in a[:i] have e <= x, and all e in a[i:] have e >

members.name: bisect_left
members.doc: Return the index where to insert item x in list a, assuming a is sorted. The return value i is such that all e in a[:i] have e < x, and all e in a[i:] have e >=

members.name: bisect_right
members.doc: Return the index where to insert item x in list a, assuming a is sorted. The return value i is such that all e in a[:i] have e <= x, and all e in a[i:] have e >

members.name: insort
members.doc: Insert item x in list a, and keep it sorted assuming a is sorted. If x is already in a, insert it to the right of the rightmost x. Optional args lo (default 0)

members.name: insort_left
members.doc: Insert item x in list a, and keep it sorted assuming a is sorted. If x is already in a, insert it to the left of the leftmost x. Optional args lo (default 0) an

members.name: insort_right
members.doc: Insert item x in list a, and keep it sorted assuming a is sorted. If x is already in a, insert it to the right of the rightmost x. Optional args lo (default 0)
